sentence: This project provides help with study design, data management and statistics for leukemia research projects.
This project studies the circumstances before firearm suicides among Hispanic adults and looks for different profiles of the people who died.
This project builds methods to find the genetic basis of human traits and diseases using large biobank datasets.
This project studies how natural immunostimulatory DNA might help restore immune system function in patients with traumatic injuries.
This project builds a blood test using nanotechnology to monitor the loss of glutathione in the liver noninvasively.
This project builds screening tools to test chemical libraries for drugs against Coccidioides in a high biocontainment facility.
This project builds a computer model that uses imaging and RNA data to predict early whether head and neck cancer will come back.
This project tries to help children and adults with undiagnosed conditions get diagnoses faster using telemedicine and a genome-first diagnostic approach.
This project studies the molecular events of Notch signaling in living cells using proximity labeling and lattice light sheet microscopy.
This project studies gene editing in animals raised for food to see how it can affect animal health and productivity.
This project builds a cheaper and more comfortable tool that tracks the patient's face to position a magnetic stimulation wand on the head.
This project studies how a key regulator of retinal ganglion cell development interacts with other proteins.
This project makes genetic tools in pigs so scientists can study heart disease, diabetes and cancer in ways that better match human biology.
This project studies an accelerated aging model of the olfactory epithelium and tests two treatments for loss of the sense of smell.
This project tests a bedrail technology with verbal and visual reminders to help hospitalized older adults keep their hands clean.
This project builds a classifier to detect lung cancers with myeloid cell infiltration and a treatment that makes them respond to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
This project studies how social isolation changes brain activity that controls mating behavior in male and female mice.
This project studies the role of citrate in amelogenesis, the formation of tooth enamel.
This project studies the molecular makeup of the cardiac intercalated disc to understand how arrhythmias begin.
This project builds and tests a coil with pneumatically controlled capacitor arrays for multinuclear MRI of metabolism.
